blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu-based Boholano filmmaker Gerard Jamora swept the SineBohol Film Festival 2026 on Oct. 23, directing “Ayo-ayo sa Nangayo” to a festival-topping eight awards. Jamora personally bagged Best Director, Best Sound Design, and Best Editing, proving how a childhood memory from Jagna, Bohol, could be crafted into the festival’s most decorated short […]...
